import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    s = data[1] if len(data) > 1 else ''
    parenthesized = False
    outside_longest = 0
    inner_words = 0
    cur = 0
    for ch in s:
        if ch == '_':
            if parenthesized:
                if cur > 0:
                    inner_words += 1
            else:
                outside_longest = max(outside_longest, cur)
            cur = 0
        elif ch == '(':
            parenthesized = True
            outside_longest = max(outside_longest, cur)
            cur = 0
        elif ch == ')':
            parenthesized = False
            if cur > 0:
                inner_words += 1
            cur = 0
        else:
            cur += 1
    outside_longest = max(outside_longest, cur)
    print(f"{outside_longest} {inner_words}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
